subject.title: fix(groq): keep default Llama agent turns within TPM limit

question: Should the Groq TPM rejection be handled by this provider-scoped retry or by the shared OpenAI-compatible transport policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104916?
rationale: The two open candidates solve the same failure but intentionally change different successful-request and cross-provider invariants, so repository owner intent is required before repairing and landing either direction.

options.title: Keep Groq-scoped recovery
options.body: Repair the unknown-provenance gap and preserve existing successful-request behavior for Groq users with higher limits and for other providers.

options.title: Adopt shared transport policy
options.body: Prefer the broader candidate only after equivalent live-provider and upgrade proof supports changing output-reservation semantics across OpenAI-compatible providers.

recommendation.title: Keep Groq-scoped recovery
recommendation.body: Repair the unknown-provenance gap and preserve existing successful-request behavior for Groq users with higher limits and for other providers.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both the Groq plugin package and the runtime model-resolution surface central to the decision.
